name: ChiSale
fix_description: In the constructor, change `if (i > bonusThresholds.length - 1)` to `if (i == bonusThresholds.length - 1)` so that maxBonusThreshold is properly set to the final tier threshold, preventing buy() from using the full token balance as the purchase cap.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is extremely short and effectively just triggers a single Balancer flashLoan call to a vulnerable receiver, with no meaningful multi-step exploit logic, price manipulation, or complex protocol interactions. A competent auditor could identify and reproduce this kind of flash-loan receiver/access-control issue very quickly.
